start.text:
First off, I want you to go
plant some trees and flowers
around my shop.

why.text:
The area around here is too
dull — not charming at all.

shop.text:
People like shopping in areas
that are clean and well kept.
So I want you to spruce
things up a bit for me.

return.text:
When you're finished, come
and tell me, yes?
